`te-maya.mp3` is the sole real GN-6 audio fixture: “అందరికీ మంచి వార్తలు.”
Generated offline using Piper te_IN-maya-medium, then ffmpeg mono 22050 Hz / 32 kbps.
Duration 2.325 seconds; 9526 bytes. Unit tests use fakes, never Piper.

Piper 1.8.0 is GPL-3.0 (offline tool; generated audio is not GPL-covered).
The maya voice uses IIT Madras IndicTTS under the IITM EULA, which allows free
distribution of derivative works. The operator's licence copy is at
`/workspace/tts-eval/indictts-license.pdf`.
